note: The Deinosuchus that the profile says ventures out into the open ocean, kept to the three true ocean areas: Kelp Vale, the Abyssal Depths and the Stonebed Shoal. It tolerates salt water and needs no fresh water. Shares the official Deinosuchus profile with the shore variant.
